description: Org-scoped webhook delivery observability for the authenticated API key. Lists the per-event webhook delivery log for your monitors — each row shows status (delivered/failed/pending), HTTP response code, error, response time, the destination URL, and timestamp — with a roll-up summary (total/delivered/failed/pending). Use this to surface SILENT webhook failures (a delivery that never reached your endpoint). Filter by monitor_id and/or status. To replay a failed (or any) delivery, set redeliver_id to that row's id; the original payload is re-sent verbatim and the replay is itself audited. Distinct from deliver_test_webhook, which sends a brand-new simulated event.

redeliver_id.description: If set, replay the delivery with this audit-log id instead of listing (maps to action:redeliver, delivery_id).

name: list_webhook_deliveries

outputSchema.description: Webhook delivery audit rows, or the outcome of a redelivery when redeliver_id was supplied. The handler wraps the API response in a self-orchestrating envelope, so the raw payload lives under structuredContent.

content.description: MCP content blocks carrying a one-line human summary of the deliveries or the redelivery.

structuredContent.description: The raw /v1/webhook-deliveries payload. In list mode: deliveries, summary, limit, offset. In redelivery mode: redelivered, delivery_id, new_status, delivery_status_code, response_time_ms, error.

deliveries.description: Audit rows, newest last. List mode only.

delivery_status_code.description: HTTP status from the endpoint, null when no response.

event_type.description: Event type carried in the payload.

id.description: Delivery row id — pass as redeliver_id to replay it.

is_simulation.description: True when the delivery came from a test/simulate call.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 time of the delivery attempt.

trigger_type.description: What caused the fire (e.g. a rate change or a simulation).

delivery_id.description: The delivery row that was replayed. Redelivery mode only.

error.description: Failure reason for the replay, null on success.

limit.description: Page size used. List mode only.

new_status.description: Status of the replay attempt. Redelivery mode only.

offset.description: Zero-based page offset. List mode only.

redelivered.description: True when a stored payload was replayed. Redelivery mode only.

summary.description: Counts across the same filter as the rows. List mode only.
